events.how_to_observe: Best viewing after midnight, away from city lights. Find a dark location with clear skies. Look toward the constellation Centaurids. Allow 30 minutes for eyes to adapt to darkness.

events.description: First Quarter — Moon is 90 degrees east of the Sun — visible in the evening sky. Half-illuminated, perfect for crater viewing along the terminator.
events.how_to_observe: No special equipment needed. Best viewed with binoculars or small telescope.

events.title: New Moon
events.description: New Moon — Moon is between Earth and Sun — not visible in the night sky. Best time for deep-sky observation.
events.how_to_observe: No special equipment needed. Best viewed with binoculars or small telescope.
